field.label: To (outbound)
field.help: ...when they are sent to this interface. Both must be enabled entries on the Interfaces tab. Only one rule per From/To pair is allowed.

field.label: Mode
field.help: This rule replaces the outbound filter of the To interface for packets from the From interface. It can be the opposite type: for example, deny <all> outbound on IoT, with a peer rule that allows _ipp from LAN to IoT.

field.label: Custom filters
field.help: In a deny rule, the single entry <all> blocks everything from the source to this interface.
